text.p: Liechtenstein will be without their only professional player, Mario Frick, because of injury for their World Cup group eight game against Romania on Saturday.
It will be the first game in charge of the Liechtenstein team for Austrian Alfred Reidl after his recent appointment as national trainer.
Ten of Romania's starting side play in other countries, with Steaua Bucharest goalkeeper Bogdan Stelea the only home-based player among the starters.
Romania: Bogdan Stelea; Dan Petrescu, Anton Dobos, Daniel Prodan, Tibor Selymess, Gheorghe Hagi, Gheorghe Popescu, Ionut Lupescu, Dorinel Munteanu, Viorel Moldovan, Adrian Ilie.
Liechtenstein: Martion Heeb; Harry Zech, Daniel Hassler, Martin Telkser, Patrik Hefti, Jurgen Ospelt, Peter Klaunser, Patrik Marxer, Thomas Hanselmann, Cristoph Frick, Franz Schodler.
